_comment_report_contact_email: Spec §5 requires a visible 'report a problem with this listing' action. Set this to a monitored inbox BEFORE launch. While it is empty the report link is hidden rather than rendered dead.
kicker_en: Flash flood from Tibet · Trishuli corridor
kicker_ne: तिब्बतबाट आएको आकस्मिक बाढी · त्रिशूली करिडोर
safety_en: Do not go to the riverbank to see how big the flood is, and do not film or photograph at the water's edge. Stay well away from the river, and help anyone who needs it.
safety_ne: बाढी कत्रो आयो भन्दै नदी छेउछाउमा गएर हेर्ने, बाढीको छेउमा गएर भिडियो, फोटो खिच्ने काम नगर्नुहोला। नदी भन्दा धेरै टाढा बस्नुहोला र आवश्यक परेकोलाई सहयोग गर्नुहोला।
